briefdescription.para: restoreCalleeSavedRegisters - Issues instruction(s) to restore all callee saved registers and returns true if it isn't possible / profitable to do so by issuing a series of load instructions via loadRegToStackSlot().

detaileddescription.para: If it returns true, and any of the registers in CSI is not restored, it sets the corresponding Restored flag in CSI to false. Returns false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if the target can safely skip saving callee-saved registers for noreturn nounwind functions.
isFPReserved - Return true if the frame pointer register should be considered a reserved register on the scope of the specified function.
hasReservedCallFrame - Under normal circumstances, when a frame pointer is not required, we reserve argument space for call sites in the function immediately on entry to the current function.

detaileddescription.para: This eliminates the need for add/sub sp brackets around call sites. Returns true if the call frame is included as part of the stack frame.

briefdescription.para: canSimplifyCallFramePseudos - If there is a reserved call frame, the call frame pseudos can be simplified.

detaileddescription.para: Unlike most targets, having a FP is not sufficient here since we still may reference some objects via SP even when FP is available in Thumb2 mode.

memberdef.name: ResolveFrameIndexReference

briefdescription.para: Returns the callee-saved registers as computed by determineCalleeSaves in the BitVector SavedRegs.
This method determines which of the registers reported by TargetRegisterInfo::getCalleeSavedRegs() should actually get saved.

detaileddescription.para: The default implementation checks populates the SavedRegs bitset with all registers which are modified in the function, targets may override this function to save additional registers. This method also sets up the register scavenger ensuring there is a free register or a frameindex available. This method should not be called by any passes outside of PEI, because it may change state passed in by MF and RS. The preferred interface outside PEI is getCalleeSaves.

detaileddescription.para: Once the frame is finalized, MO_FrameIndex operands are replaced with direct constants. This method is optional.

briefdescription.para: getCalleeSavedSpillSlots - This method returns a pointer to an array of pairs, that contains an entry for each callee saved register that must be spilled to a particular stack location if it is spilled.

detaileddescription.para: Each entry in this array contains a <register,offset> pair, indicating the fixed offset from the incoming stack pointer that each register should be spilled at. If a register is not listed here, the code generator is allowed to spill it anywhere it chooses.

briefdescription.para: This method is called during prolog/epilog code insertion to eliminate call frame setup and destroy pseudo instructions (but only if the Target is using them).

detaileddescription.para: It is responsible for eliminating these instructions, replacing them with concrete instructions. This method need only be implemented if using call frame setup/destroy pseudo instructions. Returns an iterator pointing to the instruction after the replaced one.
